name: Summer STEM Experience (New Mexico Tech)
what_you_do: Live like a college student for a week. You study one science or engineering topic. The page says you can earn college credit.
who_can_apply: Students entering sophomore, junior or senior year of high school. You need at least a 2.75 GPA and must have finished Algebra 1.
pay_detail: $675 per session. This covers food, housing and classes.
deadline_text: The page is for the 2026 session and does not show dates. Check the page for the next session.
how_to_apply: The program page says application links are at the bottom of the page. The link itself is not stated on the program page.
notes: The page says you can earn college credit. The number of credits is not stated on the program page.
